answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil swarms through cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs that bind verifiable execution traces to staking tiers. When a rogue swarm attempts mass replication, stake bonding curves enforce exponential capital exhaustion: while legitimate nodes flit lightly like a sparrow, an adversary creates a plume of escalating protocol fees. Malicious replicas sink into an unrecoverable capital lagoon, making superlinear attacker costs prohibitive.
